name: What types of windows are best suited for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What types of windows are best suited for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, privacy and moisture resistance are key. Frosted, textured, or obscure glass options are popular for privacy. Materials like vinyl or fiberglass are highly recommended due to their excellent resistance to humidity and condensation, preventing issues like rot or mold common with wood in wet environments. Consider casement or awning windows for ventilation, as they can be opened even in light rain, improving air circulation and preventing moisture buildup. Ensure any chosen window type is energy-efficient to maintain indoor comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Vinyl or fiberglass windows with frosted or obscure glass are ideal for bathrooms, offering privacy, moisture resistance, and good ventilation.
